sanskrit_verse: परद्रव्येsभिलषति योsस्वामी लोभसंयुतः । अभावयंस् ततः पश्चाद् दाप्यः स्याद् द्विगुणं दमम् ॥
transliteration: paradravye 'bhilaṣati yo 'svāmī lobhasaṃyutaḥ | abhāvayaṃs tataḥ paścād dāpyaḥ syād dviguṇaṃ damam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: He who, being devoid of ownership, desires another's property out of greed shall thereafter be made to pay double the value as restitution.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from rightful ownership, not desire or possession
Causation arises from misaligned intention rooted in greed
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by conscious awareness of ownership boundaries
Restoration logic requires proportional return of energetic and material displacement
Consciousness alignment demands correction through financial symmetry, not punitive suffering
executable_legal_axioms: IF (agent.desire_for_property == TRUE) AND (agent.ownership_status == FALSE) AND (motivation.greed == TRUE) THEN restitution.amount = 2 × property.value
IF (desire.origin == external_unowned_object) AND (greed.factor.present == TRUE) THEN initiate_restorative_payment_protocol()
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving unauthorized claims over property driven by greed, the court must enforce a two-fold restitution mechanism. The threshold of responsibility lies in the conscious intent coupled with absence of lawful ownership. Authority derives solely from dharmic title, not emotional or economic attachment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that desire without svāmya (ownership) creates anupūrvaśaḥ (causal imbalance). The doubling of compensation aligns not as punishment but as prakriyā (process) to restore energetic equilibrium. Responsibility is proportional to the distortion caused; hence, no punitive element exists—only completion of causal debt.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Financial Completion Process wherein the offender pays twice the assessed value directly to the aggrieved party
Activate Ownership Boundary Realignment Training to recalibrate consciousness regarding svāmya and aparigraha
Deploy Restitution Monitoring System ensuring full execution of payment within prescribed timeframes
Conduct Post-Restitution Integration Review to confirm consciousness realignment and prevent recurrence
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source of Dharma. This law restores balance where greed disrupts ownership integrity. Justice flows through consciousness, not coercion. There is no punishment—only restoration. Dharma prevails.
